title: T-3 alarm fires exactly once and doAlarmFired records objectName and scheduledTime
asA: developer whose SingleCellObject schedules future work via storage.setAlarm
iWant: the alarm() handler to fire exactly once per scheduled time and doAlarmFired to carry objectName and scheduledTime
soThat: the applied project can observe alarm delivery through the metadata-only sink and trust the once-per-schedule contract

acceptanceCriteria.description: A SingleCellObject with setAlarm(100) fires alarm() once. The handler drains the persisted alarm (storage.getAlarm returns null after) and emits doAlarmFired with objectName and scheduledTime. A second alarm() call on the drained storage records scheduledTime null (no re-fire for the same schedule).
acceptanceCriteria.when: alarm() is driven once and then again after the fire
acceptanceCriteria.then: the first fire emits doAlarmFired with the scheduledTime; the second fire records scheduledTime null; storage.getAlarm returns null after the first fire
